name: Shōdoshima (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shōdoshima town emblem in white: a stylised swirl of leaf-like strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Shōdoshima, a town in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 21 March 2006.

features.role: Shōdoshima town emblem — a stylised swirl of leaf-like strokes
